decisions.reason: Glazed industrial sectional doors are a core, durable line for a large door manufacturer, and this one stayed on the website through 2019 with no sign of withdrawal, so it is likely still part of the range.
Demand for insulated glazed industrial doors is rising with energy-efficiency rules, so this product fits the firm's thermal-solution focus and should be kept.
Having its own dedicated page in both years shows strong firm commitment to this industrial door, which belongs to its core business and has long product life cycles.
